notes.title: RELEASE DATE! & BIG UPDATE OF DEMO VERSION!
notes.content:
[h2]RELEASE DATE![/h2]
As announced at the INDIE Live Expo 2025.4.13 online on April 13, 2025, 
[b]The release date of “DevilConnection” is [u]OCTOBER 31, 2025[/u]![/b] 
We will do our best to produce it for release, so please register your wishlist and wait for it!
[previewyoutube=jMGC-Jrc-9c;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]BIG UPDATE OF DEMO VERSION![/h2]
To celebrate the release date decision, we have made a major update to the demo version!
New characters have been added, so please check it out!
[b]* Due to a conflict with the development of the production version, past saved data may not work. In that case, please play from the beginning (no need to delete data). [/b]

[h3]Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] [New!] A new character has been added. You can play if you complete the Day 0 once.
[*] [New!] Added “Collection” mode. You can check the list of characters and endings.
[*] [New!] Each character now has a different text sound.
[*] [New!] The UI (display of MP gauge and number of characters met) can now be hidden, except on some screens.
[*] [Specification Change] The timing for stopping the evil eye search and magic absorption has been changed to the moment the mouse button is pressed down.
[*] Other bug fixes and direction adjustments.
[/list]

Please report the bug on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3054820/discussions/0/4514381284535009768/]bug report thread[/url] when you discovered more.

notes.title: DevilConnection in TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2025! (with New Feature)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45092256/178b55c09f148dbeb550741bfc2671dbd832b779.png[/img]
We will be exhibiting “DevilConnection” at [url=https://indiegamessummit.tokyo/]TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2025[/url], which will be held on 3/8-9, 2025!
The venue and booth number is [b]Musashino Kokaido Hall 3F Conference Room 5 “CG-4”[/b] (this is a different venue from the other venue, Kichijoji Tokyu REI Hotel).
We hope to see you there.

[h2]New Features and Novelty![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45092256/7a5b2d1b84d10e1add1375d307da0bb84fe55506.png[/img]
There is big new features. You will be able to enjoy them at the trial booth.
We will also have new novelty for those who come to test play.

[h2]TIGS PUSH TITLES & PARCO LOVE GAME![/h2]
We have been selected as one of the titles to be picked up at the event as “[b]TIGS PUSH TITLES supported by Cygames[/b]”! We are waiting for you at our gorgeous booth.
PARCO GAMES has also selected us as one of their pickup titles as “[b]PARCO LOVE GAME[/b]”! During the event, the game will be introduced and stickers will be distributed at Kichijoji PARCO, so please visit there as well (Introduction of the game only. If you would like to try out the game, please visit [b]Musashino Kokaido 3F, Conference Room 5 “CG-4”[/b]).

A trial booth will be at [b]Musashino Public Hall 3F, Conference Room 5 “CG-4”[/b],
PARCO GAMES will have a booth at [b]Kichijoji PARCO Rooftop[/b].
Please make sure you come to the right booth.

We look forward to seeing you all there!

notes.title: [Demo] Major Update!
notes.content:
A major update to the trial version is available today for both Win and Mac! (English description is below the image.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45092256/441c8a4556c5dd14f32228b6ffed7259256e1277.png[/img]

[h1]Important Notice[/h1]
Due to this update, loading past saved data may not work properly.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but we ask that you play from the beginning whenever possible.
You can also use save data deletion from option screen.

[h1]Updates[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a new character. (Can meet in the second round.)
[*]An auto-save function has been implemented. You can go back to the most recent choice when loading.
[*]The number of save slots has been expanded to 30.
[*]Added conversation memory function (except when searching for evil eye). The most recent conversation can be displayed.
[a]Message skipping is now possible. [b]Please note that currently unread messages are also skipped. [/b]
[*]Lightweight mode can now be set in the options. Some of the effects of the evil eye search will be cut off.
[/list]

[h2]Specification Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Menus can no longer be opened during an evil eye search.
[*]Menu button placement has been changed.
[/list]

If you find a bug, please report it in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3054820/discussions/0/4514381284535009768/]不具合報告スレッド[/url].

notes.title: [Demo]Apology for saved data
notes.content:
In today's update, we have fixed a bug in the process regarding save data. This will make it inevitable to reset the save data. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

[h3]詳細[/h3]
DevilConnection is based on Electron due to the fact that it is developed using TyrannoScript. Briefly, the browser runs internally, and the game runs on top of it.
The game uses a mechanism called Local Storage to save saved data, but when we were working on a previous issue where the game did not work properly in an HDR environment, the key string used to save data in Local Storage had an incorrect value.
We have now corrected the key string to the correct value, and you will no longer be able to use saved data from previous versions of the software.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, but since the bug in the save data processing has been resolved and the save data is now saved correctly, theoretically there can no longer be any loss of save data.
